title: Claude-Mem
blurb: Infinite memory for Claude Code, free. Records sessions, compresses them with AI, and injects relevant context back into future ones.
body:
Claude-Mem gives Claude Code persistent memory. It records what Claude does during coding sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions.

The numbers

  • Up to 95% fewer tokens per session
  • 20× more tool calls before hitting context limits
  • 100% open source · 27K+ GitHub stars

No more re-explaining your codebase every session. No more losing decisions after /compact. No more starting from scratch.

SOURCE · claude-mem launch post. One of several "memory layer" tools in this space.
